items.title: Ube export freeze seen as opportunity to build scale for commercial cultivation
items.description: THE Department of Agriculture’s (DA) decision to suspend exports of fresh purple yam (ube) indefinitely serves as an opportunity to develop sufficient scale in the supply of planting materials to enable commercial cultivation of the in-demand crop, industry officials said.

items.title: Foreign debt service bill hits $7.298B in 1st half
items.description: THE foreign debt service bill rose 3.02% year on year to $7.298 billion in the first half due to increased principal payments, the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) said, citing preliminary data. items.description: STUDENTS will need more than artificial intelligence (AI) literacy to remain competitive in the workforce, with schools urged to pair fluency in technology with critical thinking, problem-solving, and other human skills, business organizations said.

items.description: PRESIDENT Ferdinand R. items.description: THE Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) said the planned development of Sangley Point International Airport (SPIA) in Cavite is expected to generate over P150 billion in direct investment, with the indirect economic impact pegged at P500 billion. items.description: THE National Federation of Hog Raisers said the US Department of Agriculture’s (USDA) projection for Philippine pork production of 1.06 million metric tons (MMT) in 2027 is too low, based on rule-of-thumb estimates for the meat yield of the livestock population. Federation Chairman Alfred Ng said the actual total should be closer to 1.32 MMT, […]

items.title: Bangsamoro parliamentary elections marred by ballot irregularities, violence
items.description: THE first regular parliamentary elections in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) were marred by election-related violence, pre-shaded ballots and other disruptions on Monday, prompting the Commission on Elections (Comelec) to take control of Cotabato City and Maluso, Basilan.

items.description: THE P60 wage increase in the National Capital Region (NCR) will provide immediate relief to workers but does not settle their claims under an earlier P85 increase, as questions remain over the legal status of the previous wage order, analysts said.
